quest.title: Adventure in the Land of Mists
quest.description: After finally repelling the evil dragon, you and the self-proclaimed adventurer Bona set off on a journey alongside the mysterious Cocouik to find the Tonatiuh and the Jade of Return...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.num: Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm: Act II
chapter.title: A Dream of Gazing Upon the Distant Sky

talks.objective: Follow Coco's guidance to find the Altar of Primal Flame

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't expect Coco to lead us here. This strange fortress looks just like the place where we met you, Bona.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it even has the same mural! Minus the smear marks, though. Is it because we're higher up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}! This must be the Python King that Bona mentioned. He sure looks mean!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the Python King Och-Kan. Legend has it that he abused and oppressed his people to get the Tonatiuh built, and eventually attracted the Abyss, which led to his death and the downfall of the kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: But that's just a legend. After all, the storytellers in my tribe have told different tales about what happened to him.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Maybe he's still roaming the Tonatiuh and feasting on his treasure. Or maybe the evil dragon that's been trying to stop us is his ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Kuchi...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please stop with the stories! You're scaring Coco!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} sure has been eager to do something since we defeated the dragon. Is he in some kind of secret contest with Coco?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, where's this Altar we're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: If Coco was right, it should be below us... Wait, I thought it'd be somewhere higher up.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Did we mess up? The Altar of Primal Flame can't be inside the mountain, can it? How would we be transported into the sky then, unless the mountain itself collapses?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There could be a special transportation mode at play...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what now, then? You were so sure while we were down there. And we can't understand what Coco is trying to say, either.

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Kulu...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Any ideas, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I think I get it now. It's trying to tell us that following rigid logic won't get us anywhere!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you made that up, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Well, regardless of what's below us, I say we go check it out. I mean, we're on an adventure, aren't we?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh, you sure are excited, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Well, time to figure out how to get down there.

talks.objective: Investigate the area around the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's open! You're awesome, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! We wouldn't have found the mechanism without you!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #I knew you could do it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But don't get ahead of yourself. Plenty of challenges await us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that the entrance is open, there's no reason to give up halfway.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I concur, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Cheep... Cheep!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Why don't you want to go in? Are you scared? We're halfway through our journey — there's no turning back now!

dialogues.speaker: Cocouik
dialogues.text: Ku...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You shouldn't force the issue, Bona. It really does look super scared. Could there be something super dangerous down there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm scared too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Now, really? C'mon, pull yourself together like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, why don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is kind of exciting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't think you'd be so pumped up. But you can probably take on anyone we find down there, so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, our little Saurian's a brave soul.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Coco really is afraid, maybe we should have it stay behind... But not alone. That wouldn't work...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I guess there's no other way. I'll stay with Coco up here. You can have the Pyrophosphorite.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: But, whatever you find down there, you have to come back and find me, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We don't leave anyone behind.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: I believe in you. We'll wait for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, just wait here until we come back.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, what's this? It looks gross...

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: This is nascent Abyssal Blight. Looks like it's seeping down from above... Hmm, I thought a place festooned with frescoes would be safer.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Huh? Uh-oh, I think something's gonna fall down. Watch out, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Wow, that was a shocker! Thank goodness for our quick reactions.

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: So, did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we did find something that looks like a mechanism, but it's kind of a pain...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: #Oh, I don't know what you mean, but {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looks pretty clued in, so let's check it out anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Bona
dialogues.text: Let's look a bit harder and see if we can find any contraptions or secret passages!
